name: OG Kush
summary: OG Kush is a [[kind:cut|cut]] that emerged in Florida in the early 1990s and reached Los Angeles in 1996, when Matt "Bubba" Berger brought cuttings to the grower Josh D. Its commonly cited parents are [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]], [[lemon-thai|Lemon Thai]], and [[pakistani-kush|Pakistani Kush]]; Leafly gives [[hindu-kush|Hindu Kush]] in place of the Pakistani line.

sources.title: OG Kush
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the early-1990s Florida origin and Berger bringing it to Josh D in Los Angeles in 1996; gives Chemdawg, Hindu Kush, and Lemon Thai as the lineage, and 7–9 weeks of flowering.

sources.title: OG Kush: A Quarter Century of Gas
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Berger carried about 15 cuttings from Florida, one OG Kush cut survived, and the group added "OG" to mark their original cut.

sources.title: Everything You Need To Know About OG Kush
sources.note: Gives the commonly cited three-way of Chemdawg, Lemon Thai, and Pakistani Kush.
